subject: storytime
title: Llama Llama words
about: Baby Llama is tucked into bed, but when Mama Llama goes downstairs he starts to worry, and his small fuss grows into a big one before she comes back up to calm him. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together at bedtime, with him reading the words he practised.

book.author: Anna Dewdney
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A worried little llama learns that Mama always comes back, even when she is busy downstairs.

passage.text:
Llama Mama baby bed
book kiss pajama light
red down stairs phone
wait cry shout hug
love alone

cards.note: capital L, it is his name; ll is one l; the first a says ah and the last a says uh: Lah-muh
capital M, it is her name; the first a says ah and the last a says uh: Mah-muh
the a says its name and y at the end says ee: bay-bee
oo says the short oo, like in look
ss is two letters, one sound: s
three parts: pa-ja-ma; the first and last a say uh, the middle a says ah: puh-jah-muh
igh says long i, like in night
ow says ow, like in cow
s-t blend; air says air, like in hair; the s says z
ph says f; magic e makes o say its name
ai says long a, like in rain
c-r blend; y says long i here: krye
sh is one part; ou says ow, like in out
the o says u; ve at the end just says v: luv
the a at the front says uh; magic e makes o say its name: uh-lohn
